# Chessmasters

> Chessmasters (https://www.chessmasterss.in) is an independent AI chess game analyzer and coaching web application for Chess.com and Lichess that turns a finished game into a plain-English coaching report with five core sections: Strength, Weakness, Game Overview, Focus Areas, and Resources.

Last updated: 2026-10-20

Chessmasters is an independent platform launched in 2026, not affiliated with Chess.com, Lichess, or the historic Ubisoft Chessmaster video game series. The first analysis is free and needs no account; five free analyses in total upon sign-in. Pro Student is ₹399/month for 100 analyses, and Master Coach is ₹1,999/month for trainers managing student rosters. Reports are Stockfish-enriched (centipawn loss and tactical blunder detection) and written as pedagogical coaching narratives designed with FIDE Arena International Master (AIM) Parth Kaushik.

## Product

- [AI chess game analyzer](https://www.chessmasterss.in/chess-game-analyzer): what the analyzer does, how a report is built, who it is for, and pricing.
- [Curated studies library](https://www.chessmasterss.in/studies): personalized Lichess study curriculum mapped directly to recurring tactical leaks detected in your games.
- [Opponent scouting dossiers](https://www.chessmasterss.in/scout): automated scouting reports on Chess.com and Lichess opponents covering opening tendencies, time pressure vulnerabilities, and tilt triggers.
- [Sample report](https://www.chessmasterss.in/sample-report): the five report sections walked through with the 1858 Opera Game.
- [Pricing and subscription](https://www.chessmasterss.in/subscription): free plan details (5 analyses), Pro Student (₹399/month), and Master Coach (₹1,999/month).

## Comparisons and guides

- [Chess.com Game Review alternative](https://www.chessmasterss.in/chess-com-game-review-alternative): honest comparison of Chess.com Game Review, Lichess analysis, and Chessmasters.
- [How to analyze a Lichess game](https://www.chessmasterss.in/lichess-game-analysis): the review routine for Lichess players, eval graph to training.
- [How to analyze your chess games](https://www.chessmasterss.in/how-to-analyze-your-chess-games): a five-step review routine for any platform.
- [Chess tactics map](https://www.chessmasterss.in/tactics): fork, pin, skewer, discovered attack, deflection, attraction, clearance, hanging piece, trapped piece, zugzwang — each with a training link.
